checks.detail: Frontend, native and Rust release authorities identify 5.8.0.

Roadmap records completion and every required v5.8 audit target.
Protocol 2 supplies reliable/unreliable bounds, schemas, rates, deterministic simulation and secret exclusion.
Local/direct transports, RPC authority, replication, interpolation, prediction, reconciliation and fixed-input rollback are runtime-bound.
Versioned replay/save documents compare divergence, validate checksums and sanitize diagnostics.
Networking remains optional, lazy-loaded, permission-gated and disabled by default.
Rhai API 2 exposes reviewed status/query/RPC bindings and Visual Graph receives matching manifest nodes without raw sockets.
Headless/server builds and project health fail closed on package, permission, authority, channel and transport errors.
Permanent Network Studio connects every authoring stage, explicit permission prompt, bounds, replay and diagnostics.
Every new visible workflow is localized in English, German and Chinese.
README, focused networking guide and all multilingual manuals teach v5.8 workflows and safety.
Protocol, two-process, fuzz, late-join and divergence qualification passes.
EN/DE/ZH browser matrix passes four release viewports.
Generic packager enforces the exact eleven artifacts.
